Continuing a compliance readiness review.

Anything broken?

How is a compliance readiness review going?

Short-lived tokens with refresh rotation feels like the right fit here.
MFA enforcement for admin accounts is the piece nobody has picked up. Makes sense, doing that. Turns out the slowdown was a path traversal in the file download handler all along.
Status please.
Had to untangle terraform/iam.tf first.
Carry on.
Once the release settles, automated dependency updates is where attention goes. Flaky jobs get one automatic retry.
Anything broken?
Rotation of the leaked deploy key is behind us now.
Status please.
